**Answer:** The overall maximum working pressure for these check valves is **6000 psig (413 bar)** [p. 1]. But the exact allowable pressure depends on which valve series, body material, temperature, and end connection you have — so check the values below for your specific valve.

For CH series valves, the back pressure may be limited by the end connection (the fitting type and size at the valve ends); the ratings per end connection at 100°F (37°C) are listed in the Dimensions tables on page 12 — for example, a 1/4 in. female NPT connection is rated 6000 psig (413 bar), while a 1 in. female ISO connection is rated 4400 psig (303 bar).
